projects.title: NOVA / ADA
projects.subtitle: A more personal way to interact with software.
projects.description: A private desktop voice companion exploring natural conversation, reminders, and explicit desktop actions.
projects.challenge: Bring speech, local inference, and useful desktop actions together on a personal laptop.
projects.implementation: The current ADA 0.4.3 application combines local conversation and speech with a native desktop interface, reminders, Chrome-profile selection, bounded browser actions, Spotify commands, and opt-in screen context.
projects.outcome: A working local prototype with a GitHub application/update layer. Future exploration includes an ESP32 desk companion and richer personal context.
projects.boundary: Hardware embodiment is planned. Not every Windows action or voice command is confirmed on every device. The GitHub update layer is not a complete clean-machine installer. The portfolio assistant is a separate online English assistant.

projects.title: BILLi&BoBA
projects.subtitle: A little personality. A lot of product detail.
projects.description: A mobile-first storefront for custom press-on nails, designed around browsing, sizing, and a clear purchase journey.
projects.challenge: Make a visual, detail-heavy product easy to explore and order on a phone.
projects.implementation: Built product filtering, set details, cart and checkout journeys, photo-sizing guidance, order tracking, and customer/admin flows. Added Supabase-backed media management and rotating photo/video previews.
projects.outcome: A deployed Vercel storefront with responsive product UX and an owner-managed media workflow.
projects.boundary: Do not invent current stock, order volume, payment providers, customers, or commercial results. Live catalog content may change.

projects.title: Sadafuli by Isha
projects.subtitle: A considered home for modern Indian craft.
projects.description: A premium saree storefront pairing editorial product discovery with a WhatsApp-first purchase journey.
projects.challenge: Create a distinctive shopping experience for a saree brand while making products and collections manageable for the owner.
projects.implementation: Built responsive collection and product pages, cart and wishlist flows, and protected admin management for products, images, and collections. Supabase provides authentication, storage, and row-level access rules.
projects.outcome: Deployed on Vercel with a publication workflow and WhatsApp-first checkout. The store keeps brand presentation and catalog administration in one system.
projects.boundary: Checkout is through WhatsApp. Do not claim integrated online payments, sales figures, customer counts, or conversion improvements.

projects.title: Sentinel
projects.subtitle: Turning a live feed into useful signals.
projects.description: A local surveillance prototype combining person detection, motion analysis, and an intrusion-monitoring dashboard.
projects.challenge: Connect live detection to understandable alerts without flickering states and duplicate triggers.
projects.implementation: Built a webcam pipeline with confidence-scored YOLO person detection, OpenCV motion analysis, alert-hold and stability logic, timestamped evidence snapshots, and a Flask dashboard.
projects.outcome: Validated the capture-to-dashboard workflow locally, including monitoring status and intrusion evidence.
projects.boundary: A prototype, not a certified security product. No measured accuracy, latency, or field-deployment claims are available.
